recommendation: Keep the commit. It is a bounded parallel-location fix for the same erroneous example syntax and prevents _filter documentation from contradicting the applied FHIR-41013 correction.
issue_request: FHIR-41013 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I technical correction for the R5 Composite Search Parameters section. It asked to replace the invalid example value code$loinc|12907-2,value$ge150|http://unitsofmeasure.org|mmol/L with loinc|12907-2$ge150|http://unitsofmeasure.org|mmol/L.
initial_application: The issue was previously applied by c013542438a3f239bdfb88f4cdfe55f307c4ef6d and 9aa15f6fe91fe4bfbd0803406e9eda74d21e2441, which corrected the GET and POST examples in source/search.html. The combined branch already contained that correction and had no prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-41013.
additional_context: The active source/search_filter.html page is linked from source/search.html and says token values use the same format as existing search parameters. It still contained the same invalid named-and-comma composite value. Zulip discussion identified that value form as appearing to introduce a new composite syntax, and FHIR-I minutes recorded FHIR-41013 as an auto-approved technical correction.
reconciliation: Changed source/search_filter.html line 37 from code-value-quantity eq code$loinc|12907-2,value$ge150|http://unitsofmeasure.org|mmol/L to code-value-quantity eq loinc|12907-2$ge150|http://unitsofmeasure.org|mmol/L.
source_changes: source/search_filter.html:37 corrected the _filter Observation code-value-quantity example to use the normal composite value syntax loinc|12907-2$ge150|http://unitsofmeasure.org|mmol/L.
